cohort: The study included 423 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 based on real-time reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) testing.
finding: The delta variant of SARS-CoV-2 was associated with higher rates of maternal morbidity and mortality, including more severe pneumonia and increased ICU stay, compared to other variants, though no significant difference was found in perinatal morbidity.
